#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""M2H v6_4 = M2H v6_3 plus ONE feature: an EXPLICIT-SUBSET plan (--plan/--plan-sha256, mandatory). The runner reads the
full frozen contract (identical items, order and denominators to the v6_3 contract), validates the plan with plan_items
(unique well-formed ids, contract membership at the stated position, identical canonical item SHA-256, contract order,
complete split cases, no selected item with any v6_3 attempt) and attempts ONLY the selected items, each at most once,
through the unchanged admission/pin/lease/stop/publication/reader path. v6_4 attempts use their own namespace (_h6_4)
and also hold the v6_3 singleton lock, so v6_3 and v6_4 pipelines never run together.
Historical-M2 (A2 ms01..ms08) measured re-solve over the v6_3 transport (parent Codex review v2 HOLD fixes, plus the
v6_2 re-review fixes: ONE shared predicate for all five admissions; any signal/cancellation never qualifies, and the
publication window is signal-blocked with a final cancellation check; exact covered/excluded universe).
Each item regenerates its ORIGINAL independent-B formula; a mismatch with the bound historical receipt CNF is an
explicit pre-pin BindingRefusal (no pin/job/group, unattempted, chunk ends, no veto). CaDiCaL at the original 300/600
limit, drat-trim 1200, the same exact measured predicate, one attempt, no automatic retry, ONE pipeline (singleton
lock). Frozen policy clocks: no admission at/after 17:20 PDT (independent of STOP-K1; the v6_3 gates also refuse every
later worker/solver/checker phase); the chunk deadline is the 17:57 native end minus a 120 s cleanup allowance and
the runtime refuses any group whose 2400 s budget does not fit before it.
Historical receipts are validated per revision (5, 9, 12, 14, 15) with explicit layouts, and stay ORIGINAL-QUALIFIED
only. The M2H reader accepts ONLY the exact measured v6_3 schema with every primary/pin/commit binding; there is no
historical fallback. Whole-plan retained bound = runtime plan bound + every M2H item at the ordinary per-item bound.
Parent source GO required before running.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os

import encode_skel_b as ENC
import m2_item_owner_v6_3 as OWNER

import m2_supervised_runtime_v6_3 as R
import run_m2_ms09_k1_v6_3 as TX

L = COMMON.LANE
SCHEMA = 'PA19-M2H-A2-v6_4'
RUNNER = 'run_m2h_v6_4.py'
EXTRA_SOURCES = ('src/freeze_m2h_v6_4.py','src/run_m2h_v6_4.py','src/final_m2h_inventory_v6_4.py')
POLICY_CLOCKS = {'admission_cutoff':'2026-10-18T17:20:00-07:00','native_end':'2026-10-18T17:57:00-07:00','cleanup_allowance_seconds':120}
SINGLETON = 'cycle2/m2h-v6_4-singleton.lock'
PRIOR_SINGLETON = 'cycle2/m2h-v6_3-singleton.lock'  # also held: one M2H pipeline across versions
PLAN_SCHEMA = 'PA19-M2H-SUBSET-PLAN-v6_4'
ID_RE = re.compile(r'ms\d{2}_b\d{5}(:\d{5}-\d{5})?')
SHA_RE = re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{64}')
STAGED = r'^/opt/homebrew/bin/cadical -q -t (300|600) CNF PROOF; binary DRAT staged \(zstd-1 in memory\) then drat-trim -i -t 1200$'
STREAMED = r'^/opt/homebrew/bin/cadical -q -t (600) CNF PROOF; binary DRAT streamed to drat-trim -i -t %d$'
# Explicit historical layouts (mode, stream_check_revision) -> (solver-string pattern, required drat s_lines, replay required)
HISTORICAL = {('direct',5):(STREAMED % 1800,None,False),('direct',9):(STREAMED % 1800,['s VERIFIED'],False),
              ('partbatch',9):(STREAMED % 1200,['s VERIFIED'],False),('direct',12):(STAGED,['s VERIFIED'],True),
              ('direct',14):(STAGED,['s VERIFIED'],True),('partbatch',14):(STAGED,['s VERIFIED'],True),
              ('direct',15):(STAGED,['s VERIFIED'],True),('partbatch',15):(STAGED,['s VERIFIED'],True)}


REQUIRED_ADMISSIONS = (('owner_preconstruction_gate','construct'),('owner_prespawn_gate','worker'),
                       ('worker_preconstruction_gate','construct'),('worker_solver_gate','solver'),('worker_checker_gate','checker'))


def admission_records(r):
    native = r.get('native_result') if isinstance(r.get('native_result'),dict) else {}
    gates = native.get('gates') if isinstance(native.get('gates'),list) else []
    return ({'owner_preconstruction_gate':r.get('owner_preconstruction_gate'),'owner_prespawn_gate':r.get('owner_prespawn_gate'),
             'worker_preconstruction_gate':native.get('worker_preconstruction_gate'),
             'worker_solver_gate':gates[0] if len(gates) > 0 else None,'worker_checker_gate':gates[1] if len(gates) > 1 else None},len(gates))


def admission_errors(r,cut,require_all):
    """ONE shared predicate for the five admissions of an item: every present admission record carries its phase and the
    frozen cutoff; every admitted one is timestamped strictly before the cutoff; a qualifying UNSAT needs all five admitted."""
    errors = []
    by,n = admission_records(r)
    if n > 2: errors.append('unexpected worker phase gate count %d' % n)
    for name,phase in REQUIRED_ADMISSIONS:
        g = by[name]
        if g is None:
            if require_all: errors.append('required admission missing: '+name)
            continue
        if not isinstance(g,dict): errors.append('admission record invalid: '+name); continue
        if g.get('phase') != phase: errors.append('admission phase differs: '+name)
        if g.get('admission_cutoff_epoch') != cut: errors.append('admission cutoff differs: '+name)
        if g.get('admitted') is True:
            if type(g.get('at_epoch')) not in (int,float) or not g['at_epoch'] < cut: errors.append('admission at/after the frozen cutoff or untimed: '+name)
        elif require_all: errors.append('required admission not admitted: '+name)
    return errors


def epochs(c=None):
    pc = POLICY_CLOCKS if c is None else c['policy_clocks']
    return (datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(pc['admission_cutoff']).timestamp(),datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(pc['native_end']).timestamp(),
            pc['cleanup_allowance_seconds'])


def resource_policy(n_items):
    p = COMMON.resource_policy()
    p['whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes'] = R.ALL_PLANNED_RETAINED_BOUND+n_items*R.ITEM_ORDINARY_BOUND
    p['m2h_items_added_at_ordinary_bound'] = n_items
    return p


def historical_errors(x,r):
    """Identity of one historical checked-UNSAT receipt against its contract item; per-revision explicit layout."""
    errors, rev = [], r.get('stream_check_revision')
    layout = HISTORICAL.get((x['mode'],rev)) if type(rev) is int else None
    if layout is None: return ['unsupported historical layout %r' % ((x['mode'],rev),)]
    pattern,lines,replay = layout
    m = re.fullmatch(pattern,str(r.get('solver')))
    if not m or int(m.group(1)) != x['native_seconds']: errors.append('historical solver/limit layout differs')
    if rev != x['historical']['revision']: errors.append('historical revision differs')
    if r.get('status') != 'UNSAT' or r.get('checked') is not True or r.get('solver_rc') != 20 or r.get('drat_trim_verified') is not True: errors.append('not historical checked UNSAT')
    dt = r.get('drat_trim') if isinstance(r.get('drat_trim'),dict) else {}
    if dt.get('rc') != 0 or dt.get('stop') != 'self' or dt.get('says_verified') is not True or dt.get('s_lines') != lines: errors.append('historical checker verdict layout differs')
    if replay and not (isinstance(r.get('replay'),dict) and r['replay'].get('ok') is True): errors.append('historical replay missing')
    if type(r.get('multiset')) is not int or r['multiset'] != x['multiset'] or type(r.get('b_index')) is not int or r['b_index'] != x['b_index']: errors.append('historical case identity differs')
    if x['mode'] == 'direct':
        if r.get('indices') is not None or r.get('encoder') != 'encode_skel_b.build_v2': errors.append('historical direct identity differs')
    elif not (isinstance(r.get('indices'),list) and len(r['indices']) == 2 and all(type(v) is int for v in r['indices'])
              and r['indices'] == x['indices'] and r.get('encoder') == 'encode_skel_b.build_partbatch'): errors.append('historical exact interval/encoder differs')
    if not (isinstance(r.get('cnf_sha256'),str) and SHA_RE.fullmatch(r['cnf_sha256']) and r['cnf_sha256'] == x['expected_cnf_sha256']): errors.append('historical CNF SHA differs')
    if not (type(r.get('cnf_bytes')) is int and r['cnf_bytes'] > 0 and r['cnf_bytes'] == x['expected_cnf_bytes']): errors.append('historical CNF bytes differ')
    return errors


def list_errors(x,ed):
    errors = []
    src, rel = ed.get('source'), 'cycle2/skel-b/skeletons-b-ms%02d.json' % x['multiset']
    if not isinstance(src,str) or os.path.realpath(src) != os.path.realpath(L/rel) or type(ed.get('index')) is not int or ed['index'] != x['b_index']:
        errors.append('list source/index differs')
    n = ed.get('num_placements')
    if not (type(n) is int and n > 0 and isinstance(ed.get('placements'),list) and n == len(ed['placements']) == x['list']['n']): errors.append('list denominator differs')
    return errors


def task(item,tag='h6_4'):
    if item['mode'] == 'direct':
        base = 'cycle2/m2skel_drat/ms%02d_b%05d_%s' % (item['multiset'],item['b_index'],tag)
        claim = 'cycle2/claims/m2%s_ms%02d_b%05d.claim' % (tag,item['multiset'],item['b_index'])
    else:
        lo,hi = item['indices']
        base = 'cycle2/m2part_drat/ms%02d_b%05d/batch_%05d_%05d_%s' % (item['multiset'],item['b_index'],lo,hi,tag)
        claim = 'cycle2/claims/m2%s_ms%02d_b%05d_%05d_%05d.claim' % (tag,item['multiset'],item['b_index'],lo,hi)
    return {'id':item['id'],'indices':item['indices'],'new_record':base+'.json','pin':base+'.cnf-pin.json',
            'commit':base+'.receipt.json','claim':claim}


def item_sha256(x):
    """Canonical identity of one contract item (sorted-key compact JSON)."""
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()


def plan_items(c,h,plan):
    """Exact explicit subset of the frozen full contract; items are never copied, mutated or renumbered. Requires unique
    well-formed ids, each a contract member (not an excluded case) at its stated position with an identical canonical item,
    contract order, every selected split case complete, and no selected item with any v6_3 attempt (record, pin, commit or
    claim). Returns the selected contract items in contract order."""
    assert isinstance(plan,dict) and plan.get('schema') == PLAN_SCHEMA, 'plan schema differs'
    assert plan.get('contract_sha256') == h, 'plan bound to another contract'
    sel = plan.get('items')
    assert isinstance(sel,list) and sel, 'empty selection'
    assert all(isinstance(s,dict) and set(s) == {'id','contract_position','item_sha256'} for s in sel), 'plan entry fields differ'
    ids = [s['id'] for s in sel]
    assert all(isinstance(i,str) and ID_RE.fullmatch(i) for i in ids), 'malformed selected id'
    assert len(set(ids)) == len(ids), 'duplicate selected id'
    excluded = {e['case'] for e in c['excluded_cases']}
    where = {x['id']:p for p,x in enumerate(c['items'])}
    out = []
    for s in sel:
        assert s['id'] not in excluded, 'selected id names an excluded case: '+s['id']
        assert s['id'] in where, 'selected id is not a member of the contract: '+s['id']
        assert type(s['contract_position']) is int and s['contract_position'] == where[s['id']], 'selected position differs: '+s['id']
        x = c['items'][s['contract_position']]
        assert item_sha256(x) == s['item_sha256'], 'selected item identity differs: '+s['id']
        old = task(x,'h6_3')
        assert not any((L/old[k]).exists() for k in ('new_record','pin','commit','claim')), 'selected item has a v6_3 attempt: '+s['id']
        out.append(x)
    pos = [s['contract_position'] for s in sel]
    assert pos == sorted(pos), 'selected positions not in contract order'
    for case in sorted({(x['multiset'],x['b_index']) for x in out if x['mode'] == 'partbatch'}):
        need = {x['id'] for x in c['items'] if x['mode'] == 'partbatch' and (x['multiset'],x['b_index']) == case}
        assert need <= set(ids), 'selected split case is incomplete: ms%02d_b%05d' % case
    return out


def verify_sources(c):
    assert c['schema'] == SCHEMA and set(c['source_sha256']) == set(tuple(COMMON.SOURCE_FILES)+EXTRA_SOURCES)
    for p,h in c['source_sha256'].items(): assert E.digest(L/p) == h, ('frozen source changed',p)
    assert c['supervisor'] == {'path':str(R.SUP_PATH),'sha256':R.SUP_SHA} and E.digest(R.SUP_PATH) == R.SUP_SHA


def verify(c):
    verify_sources(c)
    assert c['policy_clocks'] == POLICY_CLOCKS
    assert c['resource_policy'] == resource_policy(len(c['items'])) and c['automatic_retry_allowed'] is False and c['check_seconds'] == 1200
    assert c['binary_authority']['solver']['path'] == '/opt/homebrew/bin/cadical'
    assert c['binary_authority']['checker']['path'] == str(L/'tools/drat-trim/drat-trim')
    assert sorted(c['skeletons']) == [str(m) for m in range(1,9)]
    totals = {}
    for mi,s in c['skeletons'].items():
        assert s['path'] == 'cycle2/skel-b/skeletons-b-ms%02d.json' % int(mi) and E.digest(L/s['path']) == s['sha256']
        totals[int(mi)] = len(COMMON.read(L/s['path'])['skeletons'])
    ids = [x['id'] for x in c['items']]
    assert c['order'] == ids and len(set(ids)) == len(ids)
    direct = [(x['multiset'],x['b_index']) for x in c['items'] if x['mode'] == 'direct']
    split = {(x['multiset'],x['b_index']) for x in c['items'] if x['mode'] == 'partbatch'}
    assert len(set(direct)) == len(direct) and not (set(direct) & split)
    lists = {}
    for x in c['items']:
        assert x['solver'] == 'cadical' and x['native_seconds'] in (300,600) and type(x['multiset']) is int and 1 <= x['multiset'] <= 8
        assert type(x['b_index']) is int and 0 <= x['b_index'] < totals[x['multiset']]
        exp_id = 'ms%02d_b%05d' % (x['multiset'],x['b_index']) if x['mode'] == 'direct' else 'ms%02d_b%05d:%05d-%05d' % (x['multiset'],x['b_index'],*x['indices'])
        assert x['id'] == exp_id and SHA_RE.fullmatch(x['expected_cnf_sha256']) and type(x['expected_cnf_bytes']) is int and x['expected_cnf_bytes'] > 0
        assert E.digest(L/x['historical']['path']) == x['historical']['sha256'], ('historical receipt changed',x['id'])
        errs = historical_errors(x,COMMON.read(L/x['historical']['path']))
        assert not errs, (x['id'],errs)
        if x['mode'] == 'partbatch':
            assert x['historical']['path'].startswith('cycle2/m2part_drat/ms%02d_b%05d/' % (x['multiset'],x['b_index']))
            lists.setdefault(x['list']['path'],(x['list']['sha256'],x['list']['n'],(x['multiset'],x['b_index'])))
            assert lists[x['list']['path']] == (x['list']['sha256'],x['list']['n'],(x['multiset'],x['b_index']))
            assert x['list']['path'] == 'cycle2/m2part_drat/ms%02d_b%05d/ext.json' % (x['multiset'],x['b_index'])
        else:
            assert x['mode'] == 'direct' and x['indices'] is None and x['historical']['path'] == 'cycle2/m2skel_drat/ms%02d_b%05d.json' % (x['multiset'],x['b_index'])
    for path,(h,n,case) in lists.items():
        assert E.digest(L/path) == h
        first = next(x for x in c['items'] if x['mode'] == 'partbatch' and x['list']['path'] == path)
        assert not list_errors(first,COMMON.read(L/path)), (path,list_errors(first,COMMON.read(L/path)))
        got = sorted(x['indices'] for x in c['items'] if x['mode'] == 'partbatch' and (x['multiset'],x['b_index']) == case)
        assert got == [[lo,min(n,lo+100)-1] for lo in range(0,n,100)], ('split item set is not the exact complete B100 partition',case)
    assert c['cases_direct'] == len(direct) and c['cases_split'] == len(split) and c['split_intervals'] == sum(x['mode'] == 'partbatch' for x in c['items'])
    excluded = [e['case'] for e in c['excluded_cases']]
    covered = {'ms%02d_b%05d' % k for k in set(direct) | split}
    universe = {'ms%02d_b%05d' % (mi,bi) for mi,n in totals.items() for bi in range(n)}
    assert len(set(excluded)) == len(excluded), 'duplicate excluded case'
    assert not (set(excluded) & covered), 'excluded case is also covered'
    assert set(excluded) | covered == universe, 'covered/excluded is not exactly the A2 ms01..ms08 skeleton universe'


def recipe(c,x):
    r = {'mode':x['mode'],'multiset':x['multiset'],'b_index':x['b_index'],'indices':x['indices'],
         'skeleton_path':c['skeletons'][str(x['multiset'])]['path'],'skeleton_sha256':c['skeletons'][str(x['multiset'])]['sha256'],
         'encoder_sha256':c['source_sha256']['src/encode_skel_b.py']}
    if x['mode'] == 'partbatch': r.update(list_path=x['list']['path'],list_sha256=x['list']['sha256'],complete_denominator=x['list']['n'])
    return r


def inspect(c,h,x):
    """EXACT measured v6_3 reader: every binding must hold; nothing historical can qualify here."""
    it = task(x)
    if not (L/it['new_record']).exists(): return {'state':'MISSING','record':None,'errors':[]}
    try:
        raw = (L/it['new_record']).read_bytes(); r = json.loads(raw)
        pin,k = COMMON.read(L/it['pin']),COMMON.read(L/it['commit'])
        assert pin['schema'] == 'PA19-K1-CNF-PIN-v6_3' and k['schema'] == 'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v6_3'
        assert pin['production_contract_sha256'] == k['production_contract_sha256'] == h
        assert type(pin['multiset']) is int and pin['multiset'] == x['multiset'] and type(pin['b_index']) is int and pin['b_index'] == k['b_index'] == x['b_index']
        assert pin['indices'] == x['indices'] == k['indices'] and pin['recipe'] == recipe(c,x)
        assert pin['source_sha256'] == c['source_sha256'] and pin['binary_authority'] == c['binary_authority'] and pin['supervisor_sha256'] == R.SUP_SHA
        assert pin['cnf_sha256'] == x['expected_cnf_sha256'] and pin['cnf_bytes'] == x['expected_cnf_bytes']
        assert k['pin_sha256'] == E.digest(L/it['pin']) and k['record_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        assert isinstance(r,dict) and r.get('pipeline_schema') == 'PA19-SUPERVISED-DRAT-v6_3'
        assert r.get('production_contract_sha256') == h and r.get('pre_child_pin_sha256') == k['pin_sha256'] and r.get('pre_child_pin_path') == it['pin']
        assert r.get('runner') == RUNNER and r.get('count_for_scientific_coverage') is True and r.get('historical_receipt') == x['historical']
        assert r.get('multiset') == x['multiset'] and r.get('b_index') == x['b_index'] and r.get('indices') == x['indices']
        if x['mode'] == 'partbatch':
            assert r.get('list_sha256') == x['list']['sha256'] and r.get('complete_denominator') == x['list']['n'] and r.get('enumerator') == 'extend_b.py'
        else:
            assert not any(key in r for key in ('list_sha256','complete_denominator','enumerator'))
        if r.get('group_started'): assert (r.get('supervisor') or {}).get('supervisor_sha256') == R.SUP_SHA
        errs = admission_errors(r,epochs(c)[0],r.get('status') == 'UNSAT')
        assert not errs, errs
        if r.get('status') == 'UNSAT':
            assert not r.get('owner_cancelled') and not r.get('observed_signal') and not (r.get('supervisor') or {}).get('observed_signal'), \
                'UNSAT record carries a signal/cancellation'
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,AssertionError,StopIteration) as exc:
        return {'state':'INTEGRITY_VETO','errors':[repr(exc)]}
    enc = 'encode_skel_b.build_v2' if x['mode'] == 'direct' else 'encode_skel_b.build_partbatch'
    ex = E.expected(x['multiset'],x['b_index'],x['indices'],pin['cnf_sha256'],pin['cnf_bytes'],enc,x['native_seconds'],False)
    ex.update(binary_authority=c['binary_authority'],lane_root=str(L),source_sha256=c['source_sha256'],recipe=pin['recipe'])
    return E.inspect(L/it['new_record'],ex,k['record_sha256'])


def formula(c,x,skeletons):
    D = skeletons[x['multiset']]; sk = D['skeletons'][x['b_index']]
    special = [p for p in D['profiles'] if list(p) != COMMON.P0]
    if x['mode'] == 'direct':
        nv,cl = ENC.build_v2(D['c0'],[tuple(t) for t in sk['types']],sk['empty'],special)
    else:
        assert E.digest(L/x['list']['path']) == x['list']['sha256']
        ed = COMMON.read(L/x['list']['path']); lo,hi = x['indices']
        assert not list_errors(x,ed)
        nv,cl = ENC.build_partbatch(D['c0'],[tuple(t) for t in sk['types']],sk['empty'],special,[ed['placements'][i] for i in range(lo,hi+1)])
    return ENC.cnf_bytes(nv,cl)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('contract'); ap.add_argument('sha256'); ap.add_argument('--max-attempts',type=int)
    ap.add_argument('--plan',required=True); ap.add_argument('--plan-sha256',required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args(); R.install_handlers()
    cut,end,cleanup = epochs()
    logs = L/'cycle2/m2h6_4-chunks'/('%s-%d' % (time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'),time.time_ns())); logs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    stage = L/'scratch/m2h-publish'/logs.name
    locks = []
    try:
        for name in (PRIOR_SINGLETON,SINGLETON):
            locks.append(os.open(L/name,os.O_CREAT|os.O_RDWR,0o644)); fcntl.flock(locks[-1],fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    except BlockingIOError:
        COMMON.publish_json(logs/'singleton-refusal.json',{'status':'REFUSED','reason':'another M2H v6_3/v6_4 pipeline holds a singleton lock',
            'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')},stage)
        print('M2H singleton refusal',flush=True)
        for fd in locks: os.close(fd)
        return
    try:
        run_locked(args,cut,end,cleanup,logs,stage)
    finally:
        for fd in locks: fcntl.flock(fd,fcntl.LOCK_UN); os.close(fd)


def run_locked(args,cut,end,cleanup,logs,stage):
    """Body of main() while this process holds the M2H singleton lock."""
    if time.time() >= cut:
        COMMON.publish_json(logs/'admission-closed.json',{'status':'REFUSED','reason':'frozen 17:20 policy admission cutoff reached',
            'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')},stage)
        print('M2H admission closed by the frozen policy clock',flush=True); return
    deadline = min(time.monotonic()+10800,time.monotonic()+(end-time.time())-cleanup)
    with R.Capacity(deadline,metadata=True,wait_allowance=60):
        st = os.statvfs(L); assert st.f_bavail*st.f_frsize >= R.BASE_GATE+1024**2
        assert E.digest(args.contract) == args.sha256
        c = COMMON.read(args.contract); verify(c)
        assert E.digest(args.plan) == args.plan_sha256, 'plan hash differs'
        selected = plan_items(c,args.sha256,COMMON.read(args.plan))
        union = R.admission_union(L)
        record_vetoes = {x['id']:s for x in c['items'] if (L/task(x)['new_record']).exists()
                         for s in [inspect(c,args.sha256,x)['state']] if s in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','SAT_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN')}
        if union['persistent_vetoes'] or union['resource_stops'] or record_vetoes:
            COMMON.publish_json(logs/'initialization-deferred.json',{'status':'UNKNOWN','admission_union':union,'record_vetoes':record_vetoes,
                'init_stage':'veto-scan' if (union['persistent_vetoes'] or record_vetoes) else 'resource-stop','native_has_started':False,
                'contract_sha256':args.sha256,'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')},stage)
            print('M2H initialization refusal',union,record_vetoes,flush=True); return
        assert all(v['matches'] for v in R.binary_observations(c['binary_authority']).values())
        bound = c['resource_policy']['whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes']
        reference = R.create_census(); census = R.census_for_gate(reference)
        assert census['current_data_upper_bytes']+bound+R.OTHER_WRITER_MARGIN <= R.DATA_CAP
        admission = {'binary_authority':c['binary_authority'],'census_reference':reference,'whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes':bound,
                     'admission_cutoff_epoch':cut}
        skeletons = {int(k):COMMON.read(L/v['path']) for k,v in c['skeletons'].items()}
    records,attempts,stop = [],0,None
    for x in selected:
        if args.max_attempts is not None and attempts >= args.max_attempts: stop = 'operational tranche reached'; break
        if time.time() >= cut: stop = 'admission closed by the frozen 17:20 policy clock'; break
        if R._CANCEL[0] or time.monotonic()+2550 > deadline: stop = 'deadline/cancellation; no new native'; break
        it = task(x)
        if (L/it['new_record']).exists():
            q = inspect(c,args.sha256,x)
            if q['state'] in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','SAT_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN'): stop = 'existing persistent veto '+x['id']; break
            continue  # every previous UNKNOWN remains; no retry
        if not TX.claim(it['claim'],args.sha256,it['id']): continue

        def build():
            assert E.digest(args.contract) == args.sha256
            verify_sources(c)
            assert not (L/it['new_record']).exists()
            ref = c['skeletons'][str(x['multiset'])]
            assert E.digest(L/ref['path']) == ref['sha256'] and E.digest(L/x['historical']['path']) == x['historical']['sha256']
            raw = formula(c,x,skeletons)
            got = (hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),len(raw))
            if got != (x['expected_cnf_sha256'],x['expected_cnf_bytes']):
                raise OWNER.BindingRefusal('regenerated formula %s/%d differs from bound historical CNF %s/%d' % (got+(x['expected_cnf_sha256'],x['expected_cnf_bytes'])))
            return raw
        paths = TX.item_paths(it,stage)
        try:
            r = OWNER.execute(build,recipe(c,x),args.sha256,c['source_sha256'],paths,deadline,admission,'cadical',x['native_seconds'])
        except BaseException as exc:
            COMMON.publish_json(logs/('owner-exception-'+x['id'].replace(':','_')+'.json'),{'status':'UNKNOWN','reason':repr(exc),'id':x['id']},stage)
            if not (L/it['pin']).exists(): TX.release_unattempted(it['claim'],'M2H owner refused before pin/native')
            stop = 'owner admission/exception'; break
        if r.get('binding_refusal'):
            assert not any(os.path.exists(paths[k]) for k in ('pin','job','supervisor','worker_result','quarantine')), 'binding refusal after a pin/job/group'
            COMMON.publish_json(logs/('binding-refusal-'+x['id'].replace(':','_')+'.json'),{'status':'UNATTEMPTED','id':x['id'],
                'reason':r['binding_refusal'],'no_pin_job_group':True,'veto':None,'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')},stage)
            TX.release_unattempted(it['claim'],'M2H pre-pin binding refusal; no pin/job/group; no veto'); stop = 'pre-pin binding refusal'; break
        if r.get('unattempted') == 'before-pin' and not (L/it['pin']).exists():
            TX.release_unattempted(it['claim'],'refusal rule1: M2H refused before pin/job; no record or HALT'); stop = 'pre-pin refusal'; break
        if r.get('unattempted') == 'after-pin-before-worker':
            TX.retire_unattempted_after_pin(it,paths,'refusal rule2: M2H refused before worker; no record or HALT'); stop = 'pre-worker refusal'; break
        if not r.get('pre_child_pin_sha256'):
            COMMON.publish_json(logs/('binding-or-construction-'+x['id'].replace(':','_')+'.json'),r,stage)
            TX.release_unattempted(it['claim'],'M2H construction refused before immutable pin/native'); stop = 'construction refusal'; break
        blocked = signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_BLOCK,{signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIGINT})  # v6_3 publication window
        try:
            if R._CANCEL[0] and not r.get('owner_cancelled'):  # a cancellation after the owner composed the outcome
                r.update(status='UNKNOWN',checked=False,owner_cancelled=True,halt_production=True,chunk_stop=True,
                         safety_veto=list(r.get('safety_veto') or [])+['cancellation before publication'])
                OWNER.persist_veto(r,paths,args.sha256,recipe(c,x))
            r.update(runner=RUNNER,count_for_scientific_coverage=True,historical_receipt=x['historical'])
            if x['mode'] == 'partbatch': r.update(list_sha256=x['list']['sha256'],complete_denominator=x['list']['n'],enumerator='extend_b.py')
            raw = (json.dumps(r,indent=1)+'\n').encode(); rh = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
            COMMON.publish_json(L/it['commit'],{'schema':'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v6_3','production_contract_sha256':args.sha256,'b_index':x['b_index'],
                'indices':x['indices'],'record_sha256':rh,'pin_sha256':r['pre_child_pin_sha256']},stage)
            COMMON.publish_bytes(L/it['new_record'],raw,stage)  # primary LAST
        finally:
            signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_SETMASK,blocked)  # a signal in this window now reaches the cancel handler
        attempts += 1
        item = {'id':x['id'],'record':it['new_record'],'sha256':rh,'status':r['status'],'checked':r['checked'],'integrity_status':r['integrity_status'],
                'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')}
        records.append(item); print(json.dumps(item),flush=True)
        for gate in (r.get('native_result') or {}).get('gates') or []:
            if gate.get('census'): admission['census_reference'] = gate['census']['reference']
        if r.get('sat_candidate') or r.get('integrity_status') == 'INVALID' or r.get('halt_production'): stop = 'persistent veto'; break
        if r.get('chunk_stop'): stop = 'worker admission refusal recorded UNKNOWN; chunk ends'; break
    COMMON.publish_json(logs/'summary.json',{'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),'contract_sha256':args.sha256,'attempts':attempts,
        'records':records,'stop_reason':stop,'automatic_retry_allowed':False,'policy_clocks':POLICY_CLOCKS,
        'selection_plan':{'path':os.path.realpath(args.plan),'sha256':args.plan_sha256,'selected_ids':[x['id'] for x in selected]}},stage)
    print(logs,flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Freeze the M2H v6_4 contract: the SAME historical-M2 item derivation as v6_3, then a hard check that items, order,
exclusions, skeletons, binaries, clocks, resource policy and denominators equal the frozen v6_3 contract exactly; only the
M2H source bindings (v6_4 runner/freezer/inventory) and the schema differ.
Freeze the HISTORICAL-M2 measured re-solve contract (M2H, A2 ms01..ms08) over the v6_3 transport.
Every item is bound to its immutable historical checked-UNSAT receipt (path+SHA) whose identity is validated with
the EXPLICIT per-revision layout of run_m2h_v6_4.historical_errors (revisions 5, 9, 12, 14, 15; multiset, B index,
exact integer interval, encoder, CNF SHA/positive bytes, native limit, checker verdict). Production regenerates
with the ORIGINAL independent-B encoder and must reproduce the bound bytes before any pin.
Direct cases: one build_v2 item. Split cases: the exact B100 partition of the frozen list whose source/index/
denominator are validated; every interval must have a validated historical checked-UNSAT batch receipt, otherwise
the whole case is excluded (reported, never silently covered). Frozen policy clocks and the whole-plan bound are
taken from run_m2h_v6_4. ms09 belongs to the M9 contract; E0 needs a reviewed encode_q0b worker mode.
Metadata only (JSON reads + hashes); no regeneration, solver or checker here.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import m2_ms09_contract_v6_3 as COMMON
import m2_supervised_runtime_v6_3 as R
import run_m2h_v6_4 as H

L = COMMON.LANE
BASE = ('cycle2/m2h-a2-v6_3-contract-20261018T110631.json','835ca4b2a9e11313b1663c5c14bba7e1e9c325b06a866abc09838cac6c5a1930')
SAME = ('items','order','excluded_cases','skeletons','binary_authority','policy_clocks','resource_policy','check_seconds',
        'cases_direct','cases_split','split_intervals','automatic_retry_allowed','single_pipeline')


def digest(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def limit_of(record):
    m = re.search(r'-t (\d+) CNF',str(record.get('solver')))
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def checked_unsat(r):
    return r.get('status') == 'UNSAT' and r.get('checked') is True and r.get('solver_rc') == 20


def historical(p,r):
    return {'path':str(p.relative_to(L)),'sha256':digest(p),'revision':r.get('stream_check_revision'),
            'recorded_service_seconds':(r.get('solve_seconds') or 0)+(r.get('check_seconds') or 0)}


def main():
    items,excluded,skeletons = [],[],{}
    for mi in range(1,9):
        sk = 'cycle2/skel-b/skeletons-b-ms%02d.json' % mi
        skeletons[mi] = {'path':sk,'sha256':digest(L/sk)}
        n_cases = len(json.loads((L/sk).read_bytes())['skeletons'])
        for bi in range(n_cases):
            case = 'ms%02d_b%05d' % (mi,bi)
            dp = L/'cycle2/m2skel_drat'/(case+'.json')
            split = L/'cycle2/m2part_drat'/case
            if dp.exists():
                r = json.loads(dp.read_bytes())
                if checked_unsat(r):
                    x = {'id':case,'multiset':mi,'b_index':bi,'mode':'direct','indices':None,'historical':historical(dp,r),
                         'expected_cnf_sha256':r.get('cnf_sha256'),'expected_cnf_bytes':r.get('cnf_bytes'),'solver':'cadical','native_seconds':limit_of(r)}
                    errs = H.historical_errors(x,r)
                    if errs: excluded.append({'case':case,'reason':'historical direct receipt identity/layout check failed: '+'; '.join(errs)})
                    else: items.append(x)
                    continue
            if split.is_dir() and (split/'ext.json').exists():
                ed = json.loads((split/'ext.json').read_bytes()); n = ed.get('num_placements')
                lst = {'path':str((split/'ext.json').relative_to(L)),'sha256':digest(split/'ext.json'),'n':n}
                if not (type(n) is int and n > 0):
                    excluded.append({'case':case,'reason':'empty or invalid list: needs separate parent structural check'}); continue
                probe = {'multiset':mi,'b_index':bi,'list':lst}
                lerr = H.list_errors(probe,ed)
                if lerr:
                    excluded.append({'case':case,'reason':'list source/index/denominator check failed: '+'; '.join(lerr)}); continue
                parts,why = [],None
                for lo in range(0,n,100):
                    hi = min(n,lo+100)-1
                    cands = sorted(p for p in split.glob('batch_%05d_%05d*.json' % (lo,hi)) if re.fullmatch(r'batch_%05d_%05d(_exact|_r3)?\.json' % (lo,hi),p.name))
                    good = [(p,json.loads(p.read_bytes())) for p in cands]
                    good = [(p,r) for p,r in good if checked_unsat(r)]
                    if not good: why = 'historical B100 partition incomplete (no checked-UNSAT receipt for every interval)'; break
                    p,r = good[0]
                    x = {'id':'%s:%05d-%05d' % (case,lo,hi),'multiset':mi,'b_index':bi,'mode':'partbatch','indices':[lo,hi],'list':lst,
                         'historical':historical(p,r),'expected_cnf_sha256':r.get('cnf_sha256'),'expected_cnf_bytes':r.get('cnf_bytes'),
                         'solver':'cadical','native_seconds':limit_of(r)}
                    errs = H.historical_errors(x,r)
                    if errs: why = 'historical batch receipt identity/layout check failed at %d-%d: %s' % (lo,hi,'; '.join(errs)); break
                    parts.append(x)
                if why is None: items.extend(parts)
                else: excluded.append({'case':case,'reason':why})
                continue
            excluded.append({'case':case,'reason':'no historical checked-UNSAT direct receipt or complete split'})
    items.sort(key=lambda x:(x['historical']['recorded_service_seconds'],x['multiset'],x['b_index'],x['indices'] or [-1]))
    sources = {rel:digest(L/rel) for rel in tuple(COMMON.SOURCE_FILES)+H.EXTRA_SOURCES}
    out = {'schema':H.SCHEMA,'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),'source_sha256':sources,
        'skeletons':{str(k):v for k,v in skeletons.items()},'supervisor':{'path':str(R.SUP_PATH),'sha256':R.SUP_SHA},
        'binary_authority':{k:{'path':p,'sha256':digest(p)} for k,p in [('python',os.path.abspath(sys.executable)),
            ('solver','/opt/homebrew/bin/cadical'),('checker',str(L/'tools/drat-trim/drat-trim'))]},
        'policy_clocks':H.POLICY_CLOCKS,'resource_policy':H.resource_policy(len(items)),'check_seconds':1200,'items':items,
        'order':[x['id'] for x in items],'cases_direct':sum(x['mode'] == 'direct' for x in items),
        'cases_split':len({(x['multiset'],x['b_index']) for x in items if x['mode'] == 'partbatch'}),
        'split_intervals':sum(x['mode'] == 'partbatch' for x in items),'excluded_cases':excluded,
        'recorded_old_transport_service_hours':sum(x['historical']['recorded_service_seconds'] for x in items)/3600,
        'scope':'A2 ms01..ms08 only; ms09 in M9 contract; E0 pending reviewed worker mode; historical receipts remain ORIGINAL-QUALIFIED',
        'automatic_retry_allowed':False,'single_pipeline':True,'deviation':'rev5/rev9 recorded checker 1800s run at reviewed 1200s (stricter)'}
    assert digest(L/BASE[0]) == BASE[1]
    base = json.loads((L/BASE[0]).read_bytes())
    for k in SAME: assert out[k] == base[k], ('v6_4 contract differs from the frozen v6_3 contract in',k)
    out['identical_to_contract'] = {'path':BASE[0],'sha256':BASE[1],'fields':list(SAME)}
    H.verify(out)
    dest = L/'cycle2'/('m2h-a2-v6_4-contract-%s.json' % time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'))
    stage = L/'scratch/m2h-publish'/('contract-'+str(time.time_ns()))
    h = COMMON.publish_json(dest,out,stage)
    print(dest,h,'items',len(items),'direct',out['cases_direct'],'split_cases',out['cases_split'],'intervals',out['split_intervals'],
          'excluded',len(excluded),'old_service_h %.2f' % out['recorded_old_transport_service_hours'],
          'whole_plan_bound',out['resource_policy']['whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes'],flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    R.install_handlers()
    with R.Capacity(time.monotonic()+10800,metadata=True,wait_allowance=600):
        s = os.statvfs(L); assert s.f_bavail*s.f_frsize >= R.BASE_GATE+16*1024**2
        main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail-closed M2H (historical A2 ms01..ms08) component inventory. Counts ONLY measured-v6_4 qualified items.
A case is covered iff its direct item, or every interval of its exact complete B100 partition, is QUALIFIED.
--verify-formulas regenerates every consumed formula and compares it to the pinned bytes. Historical receipts remain
ORIGINAL-QUALIFIED only. Persistent vetoes or unknown records block final readiness. Not a global PA19 verdict.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import time

import m2_ms09_contract_v6_3 as COMMON
import m2_ms09_evidence_v6_3 as E
import m2_supervised_runtime_v6_3 as R
import run_m2h_v6_4 as H

L = COMMON.LANE


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('contract'); ap.add_argument('sha256'); ap.add_argument('--verify-formulas',action='store_true')
    args = ap.parse_args(); R.install_handlers()
    with R.Capacity(time.monotonic()+10800,metadata=True,wait_allowance=60):
        assert E.digest(args.contract) == args.sha256
        c = COMMON.read(args.contract); H.verify(c)
        skeletons = {int(k):COMMON.read(L/v['path']) for k,v in c['skeletons'].items()}
        cases,issues = {},[]
        for x in c['items']:
            q = H.inspect(c,args.sha256,x)
            if q['state'] in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','SAT_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN'): issues.append({'id':x['id'],'state':q['state'],'errors':q.get('errors')})
            ok = q['state'] == 'QUALIFIED'
            if ok and args.verify_formulas:
                raw = H.formula(c,x,skeletons)
                ok = len(raw) == x['expected_cnf_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == x['expected_cnf_sha256']
                if not ok: issues.append({'id':x['id'],'state':'FORMULA_MISMATCH'})
            cases.setdefault((x['multiset'],x['b_index']),[]).append(ok)
        covered = sum(all(v) for v in cases.values())
        union = R.admission_union(L)
        out = {'schema':'PA19-M2H-INVENTORY-v6_4','host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),'contract_sha256':args.sha256,
            'cases':len(cases),'covered_cases':covered,'open_cases':len(cases)-covered,'issues':issues,'admission_union':union,
            'formula_verification_mode':args.verify_formulas,'excluded_cases_from_contract':len(c['excluded_cases']),
            'final_component_ready':bool(args.verify_formulas and covered == len(cases) and not issues and not union['persistent_vetoes']),
            'scope':'M2H component only; historical receipts never counted; not a global PA19 verdict'}
        dest = L/'cycle2'/('m2h-inventory-%s-%d.json' % (time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'),time.time_ns()))
        h = COMMON.publish_json(dest,out,L/'scratch/m2h-publish'/('inventory-'+str(time.time_ns())))
        print(dest,h,json.dumps({k:out[k] for k in ('cases','covered_cases','open_cases','final_component_ready')}),flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pre-production binding census for the frozen M2H v6_4 contract: regenerate EVERY item's ORIGINAL independent-B
formula in memory (run_m2h_v6_4.formula, the exact production constructor path) and compare bytes/SHA-256 with the
historical receipt CNF bound in the contract. No solver, checker, helper or child process; no CNF is written.
A mismatch would make production refuse that item before pin and end the chunk, so it is reported up front.
One lane token held (metadata Capacity). SIGTERM sets the cooperative cancel flag; the census then stops at an item
boundary and writes a partial receipt (status STOPPED). Output: cycle2/m2h-v6_4-binding-census-<stamp>.json (creation-only).
Usage: m2h_binding_census_v6_4.py CONTRACT SHA256
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import time

import m2_ms09_contract_v6_3 as COMMON
import m2_ms09_evidence_v6_3 as E
import m2_supervised_runtime_v6_3 as R
import run_m2h_v6_4 as H

L = COMMON.LANE


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('contract'); ap.add_argument('sha256'); args = ap.parse_args()
    started, t0 = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'), time.monotonic()
    assert E.digest(args.contract) == args.sha256
    c = COMMON.read(args.contract); H.verify(c)
    skeletons = {int(k):COMMON.read(L/v['path']) for k,v in c['skeletons'].items()}
    checked, mismatches, stopped = 0, [], False
    for x in c['items']:
        if R._CANCEL[0]: stopped = True; break
        raw = H.formula(c,x,skeletons); h = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        if len(raw) != x['expected_cnf_bytes'] or h != x['expected_cnf_sha256']:
            mismatches.append({'id':x['id'],'expected_sha256':x['expected_cnf_sha256'],'expected_bytes':x['expected_cnf_bytes'],'got_sha256':h,'got_bytes':len(raw)})
        checked += 1
        if checked % 500 == 0: print(time.strftime('%H:%M:%S'),'checked',checked,'mismatches',len(mismatches),flush=True)
    H.verify_sources(c)
    out = {'schema':'PA19-M2H-BINDING-CENSUS-v1','started_host_clock':started,'finished_host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
        'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-t0,1),'contract':str(os.path.relpath(os.path.abspath(args.contract),L)),'contract_sha256':args.sha256,
        'census_source_sha256':E.digest(__file__),'items':len(c['items']),'checked':checked,'matches':checked-len(mismatches),'mismatches':mismatches,
        'status':'STOPPED' if stopped else 'COMPLETE','no_cnf_written':True,'production_coverage':False,
        'scope':'formula/receipt binding only; says nothing about satisfiability'}
    dest = L/'cycle2'/('m2h-v6_4-binding-census-%s.json' % time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'))
    with dest.open('x') as f: json.dump(out,f,indent=1); f.write('\n')
    print(dest,E.digest(dest),out['status'],'checked',checked,'mismatches',len(mismatches),flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    R.install_handlers()
    with R.Capacity(time.monotonic()+10800,metadata=True,wait_allowance=60):
        s = os.statvfs(L); assert s.f_bavail*s.f_frsize >= R.BASE_GATE+16*1024**2
        main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fresh post-binding admission evidence for the frozen M2H v6_4 contract (parent Codex v2 requirement), metadata only.
Under one lane token: verify the contract, scan the shared veto/STOP registry, take a FRESH exact allocated-data census,
build the same lease the v6_3 owner builds, and evaluate the real v6_3 full_gate for the 'construct' and 'worker'
phases. Nothing is constructed, pinned, claimed or spawned; no solver/checker. The receipt records the census bytes
against the whole-plan reservation (usage must be <= DATA_CAP - bound - margin), floor, RSS headroom, binary identities,
census TTL, COUNT, policy cutoff and the 2400 s budget fit. Usage: m2h_gate_preview_v6_4.py CONTRACT SHA256
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import time

import m2_ms09_contract_v6_3 as COMMON

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""PRIVATE M2H v6_4 control suite: every v6_3 family re-run on v6_4 (flow tests now drive the mandatory explicit-subset plan)
plus family S (explicit-subset selector): plan_items positive control and rejection of malformed, unknown, out-of-domain,
excluded-case, whole-split-case, duplicate, wrong-position, wrong-identity, other-contract, empty, out-of-order,
incomplete-split, extra-field, wrong-schema and v6_3-attempted selections; runner-level: ONLY the selected items are
claimed/attempted (in contract order), no plan / wrong plan hash / invalid plan refuse before any claim, the v6_3
singleton lock also excludes a v6_4 pipeline; I2 the full-contract inventory counts one complete selected split case.
Excluded from scientific coverage. Earlier header (v6_3 suite):
PRIVATE M2H v6_4 control suite (parent Codex review v2 + v6_2 re-review requirements); excluded from scientific coverage.
New in v6_3: O3/O4 settlement-window signal in the REAL owner; T12 publication-window signal (deferred, record consistent,
runner stops); T13 cancellation between owner return and publication (UNKNOWN + persistent HALT); R15-R19 the shared
five-admission predicate (worker preconstruction gate missing/wrong cutoff/post-cutoff, valid five, UNSAT with cancellation);
V1-V3 exact covered/excluded universe (out-of-domain, duplicate, overlapping exclusion names).
No solver, checker or native child is started. All writes go to private shadow lanes under
cycle2/m2h-v6_4-controls-<ns>/ (symlinked read-only inputs, real new directories for outputs); module-global lane roots
of run_m2h_v6_4 / run_m2_ms09_k1_v6_3 / m2_item_owner_v6_3 / final_m2h_inventory_v6_4 are rebound to the shadow for one
test and restored. Stubs replace ONLY the stated component (owner execute, census, gate, formula bytes, reader),
never the code under test. One real lane token at a time (metadata Capacity / owner Capacity).
Families:
  G  runtime gates: frozen policy cutoff missing/past/future; gate records at_epoch and the cutoff
  C  Capacity: 2400 s budget refused before the chunk deadline (no child); observed supervisor signal sets the cancel flag
  O  owner: BindingRefusal -> unattempted before pin, no pin/job/veto; other constructor failure -> persistent INTEGRITY
  R  exact reader: a correctly bound UNKNOWN is UNQUALIFIED; historical wrapper, wrong contract/pin/interval/list/
     denominator/runner/coverage/historical reference/supervisor pin, post-cutoff gate, direct-with-list fields and an
     evidence-free UNSAT are INTEGRITY_VETO; a missing record is MISSING
  T  runner flow: pre-pin refusal, pre-worker refusal, pre-pin binding refusal through the REAL owner, worker refusal
     recorded UNKNOWN, existing UNKNOWN never retried, duplicate claim skipped, singleton lock, frozen 17:20 cutoff,
     existing record veto / resource STOP / persistent flag defer initialization
  I  inventory: a split case with one MISSING interval stays open; readiness false
Usage: check_m2h_v6_4.py CONTRACT SHA256
"""
import argparse

REAL = COMMON.LANE
SELF = Path(__file__).resolve()


def dump(p,obj):
    p = Path(p); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    raw = (json.dumps(obj,indent=1)+'\n').encode()
    with p.open('xb') as f: f.write(raw)
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def make_shadow(root,c,limit=8):
    """Private lane: src and skeletons symlinked read-only; historical receipts/lists symlinked only for the first
    `limit` items (the only ones a flow test can attempt); every output directory is a real new directory."""
    root.mkdir(parents=True)
    (root/'src').symlink_to(REAL/'src')
    (root/'cycle2').mkdir(); (root/'cycle2/skel-b').symlink_to(REAL/'cycle2/skel-b')
    for x in c['items'][:limit]:
        for rel in [x['historical']['path']]+([x['list']['path']] if x['mode'] == 'partbatch' else []):
            p = root/rel
            if not p.exists() and not p.is_symlink():
                p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.symlink_to(REAL/rel)
    return root


class Rebind:
    def __init__(self,root,modules=(H,TX,OWNER,INV)): self.root,self.modules,self.saved = root,modules,[]
    def __enter__(self):
        for m in self.modules: self.saved.append((m,m.L)); m.L = self.root
        return self
    def __exit__(self,*a):
        for m,v in self.saved: m.L = v


def gate_providers(cut_now):
    return {'census':lambda:{'reference':{'path':'cycle2/accounting-v3/CONTROL'},'current_data_upper_bytes':0,'age_seconds':0.0,'finished_monotonic':time.monotonic()},
            'rss':lambda:{'known':True,'rss_bytes':10**8,'current_group_and_owner_bytes':0},
            'binaries':lambda:{k:{'matches':True} for k in ('python','solver','checker')},
            'count':lambda:2,'free':lambda:10**12,'clock':time.monotonic,'wallclock':lambda:cut_now}

            'busy_units':2,'lane_busy_ceiling':4,'chunk_deadline_monotonic':now+10**5,'item_deadline_monotonic':now+10**5,'admission_cutoff_epoch':cut}

        g = R.full_gate(base_lease(cut),'solver',root,gate_providers(wall_now))
        ok = (expect_err in g['errors'] and not g['admitted']) if expect_err else (g['admitted'] and g['errors'] == [])
        ok = ok and type(g.get('at_epoch')) is float and g.get('admission_cutoff_epoch') == cut
        rows.append({'name':name,'errors':g['errors'],'admitted':g['admitted'],'ok':ok})

def capacity_controls(root):
    rows = []
    orig_gate, orig_sup = R.full_gate, R.supervisor
    try:
        R.full_gate = lambda lease,phase,lane=None,providers=None: {'admitted':True,'errors':[],'phase':phase}

def owner_controls(root,c,h):
    rows = []
    x = next(i for i in c['items'] if i['mode'] == 'direct')
    orig_gate = R.full_gate
    try:
        R.full_gate = lambda lease,phase,lane=None,providers=None: {'admitted':True,'errors':[],'phase':phase}
        for name,exc,want in [('O1 BindingRefusal is unattempted, no veto',OWNER.BindingRefusal('CONTROL binding mismatch'),'none'),
                              ('O2 other constructor failure stays a persistent INTEGRITY veto',AssertionError('CONTROL source drift'),'INTEGRITY')]:
            sub = root/name.split()[0]
            make_shadow(sub,{'items':[x]})
            with Rebind(sub):
                it = H.task(x); paths = TX.item_paths(it,sub/'scratch/stage')
                def boom(e=exc): raise e

                  and r.get('integrity_status') == 'NOT_EVALUATED' and not flags and not files) if want == 'none' else \
                 (r.get('integrity_status') == 'INVALID' and r.get('halt_production') is True and flags == ['m2k3-INTEGRITY.flag'] and not files)

def settlement_controls(root,c,h):
    """O3/O4: the REAL owner composes the outcome after a (fake) clean supervision; O3 delivers SIGTERM during settlement."""
    rows, x = [], next(i for i in c['items'] if i['mode'] == 'direct')
    orig = (R.full_gate,R.supervisor,R.Capacity._settle)
    try:
        R.full_gate = lambda lease,phase,lane=None,providers=None: {'admitted':True,'errors':[],'phase':phase}
        for name,signal_in_settle in [('O3 SIGTERM during settlement -> owner_cancelled UNKNOWN + HALT',True),('O4 same flow without a signal -> no cancellation, no veto',False)]:
            sub = root/name.split()[0]; make_shadow(sub,{'items':[x]})
            with Rebind(sub):
                it = H.task(x); paths = TX.item_paths(it,sub/'scratch/stage')
                def fake_supervise(command,nm,wall,cap,floor,lane,record,quarantine,grace=60,owner_child=None):
                    rec = {'leader_pid':None,'completed_cleanly':True,'uncertain':False,'observed_signal':None,'trip_reason':None,'stop':None,

                    dump(record,rec)
                    dump(paths['worker_result'],{'schema':'PA19-NATIVE-RESULT-v6_3','status':'UNKNOWN','integrity_status':'NOT_EVALUATED',
                         'integrity_errors':[],'sat_candidate':False,'halt_production':False,'bounded_unknown':'CONTROL'})
                    return rec
                R.supervisor = lambda: types.SimpleNamespace(supervise=fake_supervise)
                def fake_settle(self,rec,_sig=signal_in_settle):
                    if _sig: os.kill(os.getpid(),signal.SIGTERM)
                    self.settlement = {'group_quiescent':True,'leader_reaped':True,'explicit_owned_popen_wait':True,'owned_leader_pid':None,'CONTROL':True}
                    self.safe = True
                R.Capacity._settle = fake_settle
                admission = {'binary_authority':c['binary_authority'],'census_reference':{'path':'x'},'whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes':R.ALL_PLANNED_RETAINED_BOUND,
                             'admission_cutoff_epoch':time.time()+3600}
                r = OWNER.execute(lambda: b'p cnf 1 1\n1 0\n',H.recipe(c,x),h,c['source_sha256'],paths,time.monotonic()+5000,admission,'cadical',600)
            cancelled = R._CANCEL[0]; R._CANCEL[0] = False
            flags = sorted(p.name for p in (sub/'cycle2').glob('m2k3-*.flag'))

                 if signal_in_settle else (not r.get('owner_cancelled') and r.get('status') == 'UNKNOWN' and not r.get('halt_production') and not flags)
            rows.append({'name':name,'owner_cancelled':r.get('owner_cancelled'),'status':r.get('status'),'halt':r.get('halt_production'),'flags':flags,'ok':ok})
    finally:
        R.full_gate,R.supervisor,R.Capacity._settle = orig
        R._CANCEL[0] = False
    return rows


def five_gates(cut):
    g = lambda phase: {'phase':phase,'admitted':True,'errors':[],'admission_cutoff_epoch':cut,'at_epoch':cut-3600.0}

def universe_controls(c):

    covered = next(i for i in c['items'] if i['mode'] == 'direct')
    for name,mut,msg in [('V1 out-of-domain excluded name',lambda cc: cc['excluded_cases'][0].update(case='ms01_b99999'),'skeleton universe'),
                         ('V2 duplicate excluded name',lambda cc: cc['excluded_cases'].append(dict(cc['excluded_cases'][0])),'duplicate excluded case'),

        except AssertionError as exc: err = repr(exc)

def bound_record(c,h,x,root,mutate=None,record_override=None):

    enc = 'encode_skel_b.build_v2' if x['mode'] == 'direct' else 'encode_skel_b.build_partbatch'

           'cnf_sha256':x['expected_cnf_sha256'],'cnf_bytes':x['expected_cnf_bytes'],'recipe':H.recipe(c,x),'source_sha256':c['source_sha256'],
           'supervisor_sha256':R.SUP_SHA,'binary_authority':c['binary_authority']}
    rec = {'pipeline_schema':'PA19-SUPERVISED-DRAT-v6_3','status':'UNKNOWN','checked':False,'integrity_status':'NOT_EVALUATED','integrity_errors':[],
           'sat_candidate':False,'halt_production':False,'group_started':False,'production_contract_sha256':h,'multiset':x['multiset'],
           'b_index':x['b_index'],'indices':x['indices'],'encoder':enc,'cnf_sha256':x['expected_cnf_sha256'],'cnf_bytes':x['expected_cnf_bytes'],
           'pre_child_pin_path':it['pin'],'runner':H.RUNNER,'count_for_scientific_coverage':True,'historical_receipt':x['historical']}
    if x['mode'] == 'partbatch': rec.update(list_sha256=x['list']['sha256'],complete_denominator=x['list']['n'],enumerator='extend_b.py')
    commit = {'schema':'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v6_3','production_contract_sha256':h,'b_index':x['b_index'],'indices':x['indices']}
    if mutate: mutate(pin,rec,commit)
    ph = dump(root/it['pin'],pin)
    rec.setdefault('pre_child_pin_sha256',ph)
    raw = record_override if record_override is not None else (json.dumps(rec,indent=1)+'\n').encode()
    commit.setdefault('pin_sha256',ph); commit.setdefault('record_sha256',hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
    dump(root/it['commit'],commit)
    p = root/it['new_record']; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with p.open('xb') as f: f.write(raw)
    return it


def reader_controls(root,c,h):
    rows = []
    d = [i for i in c['items'] if i['mode'] == 'direct']
    s = [i for i in c['items'] if i['mode'] == 'partbatch']
    cut = H.epochs(c)[0]
    unsat = lambda p,r,k: r.update(status='UNSAT',checked=True,integrity_status='VALIDATED',group_started=True,supervisor={'supervisor_sha256':R.SUP_SHA})
    cases = [('R0 correctly bound UNKNOWN',d[0],None,None,'UNQUALIFIED'),
             ('R1 historical receipt wrapped as primary',d[1],None,'historical','INTEGRITY_VETO'),
             ('R2 wrong contract SHA',d[2],lambda p,r,k:(p.update(production_contract_sha256='1'*64),r.update(production_contract_sha256='1'*64),k.update(production_contract_sha256='1'*64)),None,'INTEGRITY_VETO'),
             ('R3 wrong pin SHA in commit',d[3],lambda p,r,k:k.update(pin_sha256='2'*64),None,'INTEGRITY_VETO'),
             ('R4 wrong interval',s[0],lambda p,r,k:r.update(indices=[s[0]['indices'][0]+1,s[0]['indices'][1]]),None,'INTEGRITY_VETO'),
             ('R5 wrong list SHA',s[1],lambda p,r,k:r.update(list_sha256='3'*64),None,'INTEGRITY_VETO'),
             ('R6 wrong denominator',s[2],lambda p,r,k:r.update(complete_denominator=s[2]['list']['n']+1),None,'INTEGRITY_VETO'),
             ('R7 wrong runner',d[4],lambda p,r,k:r.update(runner='run_m2h_v6_1.py'),None,'INTEGRITY_VETO'),
             ('R8 coverage flag false',d[5],lambda p,r,k:r.update(count_for_scientific_coverage=False),None,'INTEGRITY_VETO'),
             ('R9 wrong historical reference',d[6],lambda p,r,k:r.update(historical_receipt=dict(d[6]['historical'],sha256='4'*64)),None,'INTEGRITY_VETO'),
             ('R10 admitted gate after the cutoff',d[7],lambda p,r,k:r.update(owner_preconstruction_gate={'admitted':True,'admission_cutoff_epoch':cut,'at_epoch':cut+1.0}),None,'INTEGRITY_VETO'),
             ('R11 pin binds the v3 supervisor',d[8],lambda p,r,k:p.update(supervisor_sha256='79c463589c9c5d60fddff7c4397a4e90339bdb0f5a0b2542c865c02a387573b3'),None,'INTEGRITY_VETO'),
             ('R12 direct record carrying list fields',d[9],lambda p,r,k:r.update(list_sha256='5'*64),None,'INTEGRITY_VETO'),
             ('R13 evidence-free UNSAT',d[10],unsat,None,'INTEGRITY_VETO')]
    def gated(kind):
        def m(p,r,k):
            unsat(p,r,k); g1,g2,nat = five_gates(cut); r.update(owner_preconstruction_gate=g1,owner_prespawn_gate=g2,native_result=nat)
            w = r['native_result']
            if kind == 'missing': del w['worker_preconstruction_gate']
            if kind == 'cutoff': w['worker_preconstruction_gate']['admission_cutoff_epoch'] = cut+1.0
            if kind == 'late': w['worker_preconstruction_gate']['at_epoch'] = cut+5.0
            if kind == 'cancelled': r['owner_cancelled'] = True
        return m
    predicate = [('R15 UNSAT missing worker preconstruction admission',d[12],gated('missing'),'required admission missing: worker_preconstruction_gate'),
                 ('R16 worker preconstruction admission with a wrong cutoff',d[13],gated('cutoff'),'admission cutoff differs: worker_preconstruction_gate'),
                 ('R17 worker preconstruction admission after the cutoff',d[14],gated('late'),'admission at/after the frozen cutoff or untimed: worker_preconstruction_gate'),
                 ('R18 UNSAT carrying an owner cancellation',d[15],gated('cancelled'),'UNSAT record carries a signal/cancellation'),
                 ('R19 all five admissions valid: predicate passes, evidence reader still rejects',d[16],gated('valid'),None)]
    sub = root/'R'; make_shadow(sub,c)
    with Rebind(sub):
        for name,x,mut,special,want in cases:
            override = (REAL/x['historical']['path']).read_bytes() if special == 'historical' else None
            bound_record(c,h,x,sub,mut,override)
            q = H.inspect(c,h,x)
            rows.append({'name':name,'id':x['id'],'state':q['state'],'errors':[str(e)[:200] for e in q.get('errors') or []][:3],'ok':q['state'] == want})
        for name,x,mut,msg in predicate:
            bound_record(c,h,x,sub,mut,None)
            q = H.inspect(c,h,x); text = ' '.join(str(e) for e in q.get('errors') or [])
            own = ('required admission missing','admission cutoff differs','admission at/after the frozen cutoff','admission phase differs',
                   'required admission not admitted','admission record invalid','UNSAT record carries a signal/cancellation')
            ok = q['state'] == 'INTEGRITY_VETO' and ((msg in text) if msg else not any(o in text for o in own))
            rows.append({'name':name,'id':x['id'],'state':q['state'],'errors':[str(e)[:240] for e in q.get('errors') or []][:3],'ok':ok})
        q = H.inspect(c,h,d[11])
        rows.append({'name':'R14 missing record','id':d[11]['id'],'state':q['state'],'ok':q['state'] == 'MISSING'})
    return rows

    def execute(self,constructor,recipe,contract_sha,source_sha,paths,deadline,admission,solver='kissat',seconds=600):
        self.calls.append(paths['id'])
        base = {'pipeline_schema':'PA19-SUPERVISED-DRAT-v6_3','status':'UNKNOWN','checked':False,'integrity_status':'NOT_EVALUATED','integrity_errors':[],
                'sat_candidate':False,'halt_production':False,'group_started':False,'production_contract_sha256':contract_sha,
                'multiset':recipe['multiset'],'b_index':recipe['b_index'],'indices':recipe.get('indices'),
                'encoder':'encode_skel_b.build_v2' if recipe['mode'] == 'direct' else 'encode_skel_b.build_partbatch'}
        if self.mode == 'pre-pin': return dict(base,unattempted='before-pin',chunk_stop=True,resource_refusal=['CONTROL refusal'])
        x = next(i for i in self.c['items'] if i['id'] == paths['id'])
        pin = {'schema':'PA19-K1-CNF-PIN-v6_3','production_contract_sha256':contract_sha,'multiset':recipe['multiset'],'b_index':recipe['b_index'],
               'indices':recipe.get('indices'),'cnf_sha256':x['expected_cnf_sha256'],'cnf_bytes':x['expected_cnf_bytes'],'recipe':recipe,
               'source_sha256':source_sha,'supervisor_sha256':R.SUP_SHA,'binary_authority':admission['binary_authority']}
        ph = dump(paths['pin'],pin)
        base.update(cnf_sha256=x['expected_cnf_sha256'],cnf_bytes=x['expected_cnf_bytes'],pre_child_pin_sha256=ph,pre_child_pin_path=str(Path(paths['pin']).relative_to(H.L)))
        if self.mode == 'pre-worker':
            dump(paths['job'],{'schema':'PA19-NATIVE-JOB-v6_3','CONTROL':True})
            return dict(base,unattempted='after-pin-before-worker',chunk_stop=True,resource_refusal=['CONTROL refusal'])
        if self.mode in ('unknown-continue','unknown-continue-cancel'):
            if self.mode == 'unknown-continue-cancel': os.kill(os.getpid(),signal.SIGTERM)  # cancel handler runs before the runner publishes
            return dict(base,chunk_stop=False,bounded_unknown='CONTROL native limit')
        return dict(base,chunk_stop=True,resource_refusal=['CONTROL worker admission refusal'])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Creation-only explicit-subset plan for the frozen M2H v6_4 contract. Each entry carries the contract position and the
canonical item SHA-256 (run_m2h_v6_4.item_sha256); the plan is validated with run_m2h_v6_4.plan_items, the runner's own
predicate, before it is published. Items are referenced, never copied, mutated or renumbered; denominators stay those
of the full contract. Metadata only (one lane token): no claim, pin, record or native work.
Usage: freeze_m2h_v6_4_plan.py CONTRACT SHA256 ID [ID ...]
"""
import argparse
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import m2_ms09_contract_v6_3 as COMMON
import m2_ms09_evidence_v6_3 as E
import m2_supervised_runtime_v6_3 as R
import run_m2h_v6_4 as H

L = COMMON.LANE


def main():

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Creation-only source-review pack for the M2H v6_4 explicit-subset selector (parent instruction after the v6_3 pilot):
exact and rename-normalized deltas v6_3 -> v6_4 for every M2H file, the new plan freezer, the frozen v6_4 contract with
its identical-items proof against the v6_3 contract, the complete binding census, the control receipt, a fresh gate
preview, the frozen four-interval plan and a requirement -> implementation map. Transport v6_3 and supervisor v6 are
unchanged (pins re-verified). Metadata only.
Usage: freeze_m2h_v6_4_review_pack.py CONTRACT PLAN CONTROLS CENSUS GATE_PREVIEW
"""
import argparse
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import m2_ms09_contract_v6_3 as COMMON
import m2_supervised_runtime_v6_3 as R
import run_m2h_v6_4 as H

L = COMMON.LANE
V63_CONTRACT = ('cycle2/m2h-a2-v6_3-contract-20261018T110631.json','835ca4b2a9e11313b1663c5c14bba7e1e9c325b06a866abc09838cac6c5a1930')
V63_PACK = ('cycle2/m2h-v6_3-review-pack-20261018T113603.json','07214aa1b0fed523221c3f559717982bc28d30a0b95c0e98e73530c84449c115')
FILES = ['run_m2h','freeze_m2h','final_m2h_inventory','m2h_binding_census','m2h_gate_preview','check_m2h']
PAIRS = [('run_m2h_v6_3','run_m2h_v6_4'),('freeze_m2h_v6_3','freeze_m2h_v6_4'),('final_m2h_inventory_v6_3','final_m2h_inventory_v6_4'),
         ('m2h_binding_census_v6_3','m2h_binding_census_v6_4'),('m2h_gate_preview_v6_3','m2h_gate_preview_v6_4'),('check_m2h_v6_3','check_m2h_v6_4'),
         ('m2h-a2-v6_3-contract','m2h-a2-v6_4-contract'),('m2h-v6_3-','m2h-v6_4-'),('PA19-M2H-A2-v6_3','PA19-M2H-A2-v6_4'),
         ('PA19-M2H-INVENTORY-v6_3','PA19-M2H-INVENTORY-v6_4'),('PA19-M2H-V6_3-','PA19-M2H-V6_4-'),('M2H v6_3','M2H v6_4'),
         ('measured-v6_3','measured-v6_4'),('_h6_3','_h6_4'),('m2h6_3','m2h6_4')]
REQUIREMENTS = [
 ('keep the full 5,580-item contract identities and denominators; no item mutation or renumbering',
  'freeze_m2h_v6_4 derives items exactly as v6_3 and asserts items, order, exclusions, skeletons, binaries, clocks, resource policy, '
  'case/interval counts, retry and single-pipeline flags EQUAL the frozen v6_3 contract; the contract records identical_to_contract; '
  'plans reference items by id + position + canonical item SHA-256 and never copy them'),
 ('exact unique IDs, membership checked',
  'run_m2h_v6_4.plan_items: schema, contract SHA, non-empty, exact entry fields, well-formed ids, unique ids, not an excluded case, '
  'member at the stated position, identical canonical item, contract order, complete split cases (controls S0-S14, S19)'),
 ('existing v6_3 attempts remain distinct',
  'v6_4 uses its own namespace (_h6_4 records/pins/commits, m2h6_4_ claims, m2h6_4-chunks); plan_items refuses any selected item with a '
  'v6_3 record, pin, commit or claim (control S15 on the live pilot record ms01_b00045); v6_3 records are read by the v6_3 reader only'),
 ('no bypass of admission/pins/leases/stop/reader',
  'only the loop iterable changes (for x in selected); owner execute, gates, pins, claims, capacity leases, stop/cancel/HALT checks, '
  'publication window, exact reader and inventory are the v6_3 code unchanged (rename-normalized delta); all v6_3 control families re-run'),
 ('deterministic controls: unknown/duplicate/out-of-contract IDs rejected; only selected items attempted',
  'S1-S15 unit rejections, S16 runner claims/attempts exactly the four selected intervals in contract order, S17-S19 no plan / wrong '
  'plan hash / invalid plan refuse before any claim, S20 a held v6_3 singleton refuses v6_4, I2 inventory counts one complete case of 5,424'),
 ('one pipeline', 'v6_4 holds BOTH the v6_3 and the v6_4 singleton locks'),
 ('17:20 admission / 17:57 end unchanged', 'POLICY_CLOCKS unchanged and bound in the identical contract fields')]


def digest(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def udiff(a,b,fa,fb):
    return ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(a.splitlines(True),b.splitlines(True),fromfile=fa,tofile=fb))


def normalize(t):
    for a,b in PAIRS: t = t.replace(b,a)
    return t


def write_x(path,text):
    with path.open('x') as f: f.write(text)
    return {'path':str(path.relative_to(L)),'sha256':digest(path),'bytes':path.stat().st_size}


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    for a in ('contract','plan','controls','census','gate_preview'): ap.add_argument(a)
    args = ap.parse_args(); stamp = time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')
    assert digest(L/V63_PACK[0]) == V63_PACK[1] and digest(L/V63_CONTRACT[0]) == V63_CONTRACT[1]
    c = json.loads(Path(args.contract).read_bytes()); csha = digest(args.contract); H.verify(c)
    c63 = json.loads((L/V63_CONTRACT[0]).read_bytes())
    same = c['identical_to_contract']['fields']
    assert c['identical_to_contract']['sha256'] == V63_CONTRACT[1] and all(c[k] == c63[k] for k in same)
    transport = {p:h for p,h in c['source_sha256'].items() if p not in H.EXTRA_SOURCES}
    assert transport == {p:h for p,h in c63['source_sha256'].items() if p not in ('src/freeze_m2h_v6_3.py','src/run_m2h_v6_3.py','src/final_m2h_inventory_v6_3.py')}, \
        'transport/supervisor sources differ from the v6_3 contract'
    exact,normal,files = [],[],{}
    for b in FILES:
        a,n = (L/('src/%s_v6_3.py' % b)).read_text(),(L/('src/%s_v6_4.py' % b)).read_text()
        exact.append(udiff(a,n,'src/%s_v6_3.py' % b,'src/%s_v6_4.py' % b))
        nd = udiff(a,normalize(n),'src/%s_v6_3.py' % b,'src/%s_v6_4.py [M2H renames normalized]' % b)
        normal.append(nd)
        files['src/%s_v6_4.py' % b] = {'sha256':digest(L/('src/%s_v6_4.py' % b)),'base':'src/%s_v6_3.py' % b,'base_sha256':digest(L/('src/%s_v6_3.py' % b)),
            'normalized_changed_lines':sum(1 for s in nd.splitlines() if s[:1] in '+-' and not s.startswith(('+++','---'))),'content':n}
    for extra in ('src/freeze_m2h_v6_4_plan.py','src/freeze_m2h_v6_4_review_pack.py'):
        files[extra] = {'sha256':digest(L/extra),'base':None,'content':(L/extra).read_text()}
    d_exact = write_x(L/'cycle2'/('m2h-v6_3-to-v6_4-exact-delta-%s.diff' % stamp),''.join(exact))
    d_norm = write_x(L/'cycle2'/('m2h-v6_3-to-v6_4-rename-normalized-delta-%s.diff' % stamp),''.join(normal))
    plan = json.loads(Path(args.plan).read_bytes()); psha = digest(args.plan)
    chosen = [x['id'] for x in H.plan_items(c,csha,plan)]
    ctl = json.loads(Path(args.controls).read_bytes())
    assert ctl['all_expected'] is True and ctl['contract_sha256'] == csha and ctl['control_source_sha256'] == digest(L/'src/check_m2h_v6_4.py') and ctl['sources'] == c['source_sha256']
    cen = json.loads(Path(args.census).read_bytes())
    assert cen['contract_sha256'] == csha and cen['status'] == 'COMPLETE' and cen['checked'] == len(c['items']) == cen['matches'] and not cen['mismatches']
    gp = json.loads(Path(args.gate_preview).read_bytes())
    assert gp['contract_sha256'] == csha and gp['usage_within_reservation'] and gp['budget_2400_fits'] and all(g['admitted'] for g in gp['gates'].values())
    rel = lambda p: str(Path(p).resolve().relative_to(L))
    pack = {'schema':'PA19-M2H-V6_4-SELECTOR-REVIEW-PACK-v1','host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
        'status':'FROZEN FOR PARENT SOURCE REVIEW; no native launch until a separate parent GO',
        'requirements_map':[{'requirement':a,'implementation':b} for a,b in REQUIREMENTS],
        'unchanged':{'transport_and_supervisor_sources':transport,'previous_pack':{'path':V63_PACK[0],'sha256':V63_PACK[1]},
                     'v6_3_contract':{'path':V63_CONTRACT[0],'sha256':V63_CONTRACT[1]}},
        'm2h_v6_4':{'files':files,'exact_delta_vs_v6_3':d_exact,'rename_normalized_delta_vs_v6_3':d_norm,
            'normalized_changed_lines':{k:v.get('normalized_changed_lines') for k,v in files.items()}},
        'contract':{'path':rel(args.contract),'sha256':csha,'items':len(c['items']),'identical_to_contract':c['identical_to_contract'],
                    'cases_direct':c['cases_direct'],'cases_split':c['cases_split'],'split_intervals':c['split_intervals'],
                    'excluded_cases':len(c['excluded_cases']),'policy_clocks':c['policy_clocks']},
        'plan':{'path':rel(args.plan),'sha256':psha,'items':plan['items'],'validated_selection':chosen},
        'binding_census':{'path':rel(args.census),'sha256':digest(args.census),'checked':cen['checked'],'matches':cen['matches'],'mismatches':len(cen['mismatches'])},
        'controls':{'path':rel(args.controls),'sha256':digest(args.controls),'native_children_started':ctl['native_children_started'],
                    'cases':{fam:[{'name':r['name'],'ok':r['ok']} for r in rows] for fam,rows in ctl['families'].items()}},
        'gate_preview':{'path':rel(args.gate_preview),'sha256':digest(args.gate_preview),'census_bytes':gp['census']['current_data_upper_bytes'],
                        'usage_limit_bytes':gp['usage_limit_bytes'],'gates':{k:(g['admitted'],g['errors']) for k,g in gp['gates'].items()}},
        'scope':'source review only; a split-path run would be pilot evidence for one case (4 intervals); no PA19 or M2 completeness; '
                'v6_3 pilot records remain v6_3-only; M6/M9/E0 parked',
        'generator_sha256':digest(__file__)}
    dest = L/'cycle2'/('m2h-v6_4-review-pack-%s.json' % stamp)
    with dest.open('x') as f: json.dump(pack,f,indent=1); f.write('\n')
    print(dest,digest(dest),flush=True)
    print(json.dumps({'exact':d_exact,'normalized':d_norm,'normalized_changed_lines':pack['m2h_v6_4']['normalized_changed_lines'],
                      'contract':{k:pack['contract'][k] for k in ('path','sha256','items')},'plan':{k:pack['plan'][k] for k in ('path','sha256','validated_selection')},
                      'census':pack['binding_census'],'gate_preview':{k:pack['gate_preview'][k] for k in ('path','sha256','census_bytes','gates')}},indent=1),flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    R.install_handlers()
    with R.Capacity(time.monotonic()+3600,metadata=True,wait_allowance=60):
        s = os.statvfs(L); assert s.f_bavail*s.f_frsize >= R.BASE_GATE+16*1024**2
        main()
